title: Complete binary-frame ceiling for PR551: no next kappa tick with fixed owners
body:
For **PR551's fixed scalar word and complete owner schedule**, no simultaneous reassignment of its binary gate frames admits complex **b ≥ 0.001594507308884431019638**. This is the next 10^-24 grid point above its admitted rate. Under the retained outer engine, the exact bound also excludes the next κ tick, **0.001591968902833347**.

This is a scoped exclusion, not a new κ record. It replaces repeated local frame searches with a proof covering every legal choice of F₂⁹ subspaces for all 3,657 A/B event frames, including the prefix.

The verifier derives all lower/upper frame intervals from the actual register dependency graph. Their quotient dimensions are at most three, allowing complete enumeration. The 2,375 variable events split into 71 components. Exact rational duals certify a relaxation containing every literal frame assignment: **26,470 constraints and 34,685 columns**, rebuilt from the word. Both independent rational moment engines check every nonzero reduced cost and the strict global rejection. No optimizer, NumPy or SciPy is imported by replay; floating-point discovery output is not trusted.

```sh
python -B research/frame-domain-ceiling/verify.py --work /absolute/new/frame-ceiling
```

The Python3.11+ standard-library verifier reconstructs the pinned PR551 word, preserves its source notices, and rejects a missing component, corrupted dual, missing domain choice and an attempt to exclude the already admitted endpoint. Final macOS/Python3.14.8 and Linux/Python3.11.15 replays passed with **byte-identical RESULT.json**, SHA256 `cf8a5b239b947e0a5cac2a3a76cde1e6d7e444a5874e4874fcdbd4b5ffa63f80`. Receipts are in `research/frame-domain-ceiling-validation`. Dedicated CI is monitored separately and is not claimed green.

The word, scalar operation order, starts, cut, endpoints, helper widths, owners and bad-class charge are fixed. Scalar rewrites/reordering, different cuts or helpers, owner repacking, nonbinary frames and new outer arguments are outside the theorem. The graph relaxation permits charged center climbs beyond those literally present, which only enlarges the feasible set; all actual legal assignments remain covered. The result does not discharge the inherited all-size or analytic interfaces and does not establish κ = 1.

Attribution: PR551; Dugongue's PR548 and PR541; rohanarun/Claude's PR534 frames; icekylinx's PR535/531; DreamingOfClouds' PR484/compiler lineage; the inherited exact moment and outer engines. Original author, license and assistance notices remain byte-identical and Git-blob pinned. Prepared for chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance.
